name: 需求分析子链-26-27-28
observations: 业务使命: 业务用户提交自然语言需求, 9分钟内产出专业需求分析说明书+结构化IR
三轮循环控制流: Round1 PM完善+出3题 → Round2 联合精化+出3题 → Round3 确认+出3题+工程一次性保障
26号=数据基座(≈92%完成), 27号=三轮编排器(0%), 28号=渲染器+一致性+评分(≈12%)
架构哲学: 前两轮零工程步骤, 第3轮一次性保障; SA全量重编译非cascadeUpdate; DDD实时推导不存储

name: Clarification交互机制
observations: 出题: yield ClarificationRequested事件(fragment=in-progress) + SSE推clarification_requested, 然后 yield break 暂停
收答案: 用户API回答 -> 写ClarificationAnswered事件(fragment变stable) -> Skill重跑读到stable继续
事件类型在 IrEventTypes.cs: ClarificationRequested/ClarificationAnswered
数据结构: ClarificationSet(SetId/Stage/Round/Title/Intro/Questions/AllowSkipNonCritical) -> List<ClarificationQuestion>
ClarificationQuestion字段: Id/Text/Type(single/multi/text)/Required/Options + 26号新增ContextHint/DefaultOption/QuestionFormat(SINGLE/MULTI/MATRIX_SINGLE/MATRIX_MULTI)/MatrixSubItems
ClarificationAnswer: QuestionId/OptionIds/List/FreeText
参考实现: SystemDesignClarificationSkill.cs 两阶段暂停-恢复模式

name: AnalystSkillService-FinalizeAsync
observations: 文件: Skills/AnalystSkillService.cs:269-343
签名: private Task<AppendIrEventRequest> FinalizeAsync(context, compileResult, businessEventCount, enableFinalization, ct)
enableFinalization=false(Round1/2): 只编译SA+产出AnalysisCompleted标记, 不投影/门禁/Materializer
enableFinalization=true(Round3): 投影ai_entity_field->轻量校验->R1-R3门禁->Materializer九表->sa_assumptions落库
27号编排器Round3调用此方法做一次性工程保障
问题: ThinkAsyncWithRoundAsync(enableFinalization)方法在注释里提到但实际未实现, ThinkAsync硬编码enableFinalization:true
